intro: An overwhelming, otherworldly presence fills the air…$Then, {{arceusName}} appears before you!
title: The Arceus Trial
description:
The Legendary Pokémon Arceus wishes to test your strength.
Defeat it, and you will permanently obtain Arceus's true power - the Heavenly Flute.

1.label: Accept the trial
1.tooltip:
(-) Extremely Tough Battle
(+) Unlocks the Heavenly Flute
1.selected: Arceus fixes you with a piercing gaze.$The trial begins!

2.label: Turn away
2.selected: Arceus watches you in silence.$You quietly turn away.

outro: Arceus lets out a low, resonant cry as its power recedes.$"You who carry the seed of all things... you have passed my trial."$The Heavenly Flute appears in your hands!
